The selected Grayscale Link Monster's own procedure determines which hand Monsters are otherwise legal; the temporary grant is reset after the Summon attempt.
effects.notes: Fixed: the hand-material grant no longer pre-filters to Grayscale LIGHT Fiends; any Monster in hand that the chosen Grayscale Link procedure legally accepts can now be used.
